title: Vyasa marketplace index
description: The document a Vyasa install reads from registry_url. Generated from listings/ by tools/registry.py build; do not edit by hand.

schema.description: Document schema version. A site refuses a schema newer than its build understands.

name.description: Must equal the name inside the package. A registry cannot rename a package on the way in.

version.description: Semver for plugins, an integer for themes, matching the package manifest.

url.description: Package location. https only; the server refuses anything else.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the package bytes. Always checked, signature or not.

signature.description: Hex ed25519 signature over the package bytes, verified against registry_trusted_keys.

capabilities.description: Plugins: exactly what the manifest requests. Shown to an operator before install and diffed on update.
